detail.claim: data round-trip across two builds of the same source; NOT a schema migration
schema-12 bundle restored by the schema-13 build; append-only migration on first start keeps every user record and adds empty routing tables
a schema-13 state/bundle is refused by the schema-12 build; no down-migration, no data deletion, no silent open
detail.restoreMessage: Manifest evidence format version is unsupported

limitations: Section A is a rebuild/tag comparison of one source: it proves the data round-trip, not a version migration.
Sections B/C use one frozen older install artifact (schema 12) and one current build (schema 13) on darwin/arm64 only; other platforms, ABIs and intermediate schema versions are NOT_TESTED.
Rollback restores state bytes; it does not downgrade installed binaries and is not a downgrade path.
No user service, native executor or model call; all roots and ports are isolated.
